def parse(s): return [list(map(int, row.split())) for row in s.splitlines()]
D1i,D1o=parse(d1i),parse(d1o)
def find_components(grid, marker):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); coords={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==marker}; comps=[]
    while coords:
        todo=[coords.pop()]; comp=set(todo)
        while todo:
            r,c=todo.pop()
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if q in coords: coords.remove(q); comp.add(q); todo.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    return comps
def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); vals={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,)}
    # unique marker is the least frequent nonzero color in these examples
    marker=min(vals,key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    comps=find_components(grid,marker); comp=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); c0=min(c for r,c in comp)
    pat={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in comp}
    ph=max(r for r,c in pat)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pat)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(H-ph+1):
        for c in range(W-pw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in pat):
                for dr,dc in pat: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out
pred1=transform(D1i)
print('demo1 exact?',pred1==D1o,'diff',sum(a!=b for ra,rb in zip(pred1,D1o) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
